items.title: 16.6 Anions ki pehchan ke tests (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.6 with Figure 16.7 and Quick Check 16.3, printed pages 342-344.

blocks.text: Anions (acid radicals) solid namoone par in tests se pehchane jate hain, har ek apne tajurbe, mushahide aur nateeje (inference) ke saath.

Saaf test tube mein taqreeban 2 g solid carbonate namoona lein aur taqreeban 5 cm3 halka (dilute) HCl dalein; nikalne wali gas lime water se guzarein. Jhaag (effervescence) uthta hai, gas tezi se nikalti hai aur lime water ko doodhiya kar deti hai: carbonate ions ki nishandahi.

blocks.title: Carbonate test
blocks.text: CO3 2-(aq) + 2H+(aq) -> H2O(l) + CO2(g); Ca(OH)2(aq) + CO2(g) -> CaCO3(s) (safed ppt) + H2O(l)
b) Chloride, bromide aur iodide, Cl-, Br-, I-

Test tube mein 2 g solid namoona lein aur aqueous solution banane ko 5 cm3 distilled water dalein. Solution ko tezabi karne ko halke HNO3 ke chand qatre dalein, phir taqreeban 5 cm3 aqueous AgNO3. Gaarha safed precipitate jo aqueous NH3 mein hal ho jaye Cl- batata hai; gaarha cream-peela precipitate Br-; chamakdar peela precipitate I- (Figure 16.7). Halka nitric acid is liye dala jata hai ke carbonate ions halide ions ke saath precipitate na hon.

blocks.title: Silver halides
blocks.text: Ag+(aq) + Cl-(aq) -> AgCl(s) safed ppt; Ag+(aq) + Br-(aq) -> AgBr(s) cream-peela ppt; Ag+(aq) + I-(aq) -> AgI(s) chamakdar peela ppt

Saaf test tube mein 2 g solid namoona lein aur 5 cm3 distilled water mein hal karein. 5 cm3 sodium hydroxide solution dalein, phir 3 g aluminium dhaat ka powder. Test tube ke munh ke paas ammonia gas ki khaas boo mehsoos hoti hai aur gas laal litmus kaghaz ko neela kar deti hai: nitrate ions ki nishandahi. Aluminium dhaat nitrate ions ko ammonium ions mein reduce karti hai, jo aqueous NaOH se react kar ke ammonia nikalte hain; aluminium se nitrate ka reduction redox reaction hai jis mein aluminium reducing agent ka kaam karta hai.

Saaf test tube mein 3 g solid namoona lein aur 5 cm3 distilled water mein hal karein. Halke HNO3 ke chand qatron se solution tezabi karein aur 5 cm3 barium nitrate solution dalein. BaSO4 ka bhari safed precipitate banta hai: sulfate ions ki nishandahi. Halka nitric acid na-paki ke taur par maujood kisi carbonate ions ko khatam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: carbonate, halides, nitrate aur sulfate ke liye ion, reagent, mushahida aur reaction ki anion tests ki table, safed, cream aur peele silver halides ke teen daairon ke saath. Neeche: Al3+, NH4+, Ca2+, Cr3+, Cu2+, Fe2+, Fe3+ aur Zn2+ ke liye sodium hydroxide aur aqueous ammonia ke saath cation tests ki table, hydroxide equations aur rang ke namoonon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Salt analysis mein anions aur cations ki pehchan (topics 16.6 aur 16.7 aur Figure 16.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Carbonate halke hydrochloric acid se tez jhaag deta hai aur gas lime water ko doodhiya karti hai. Halides, carbonate hatane ko halke nitric acid se tezabi karne ke baad, silver ke precipitates dete hain: chloride ke liye safed aur ammonia mein halne wala, bromide ke liye cream-peela, iodide ke liye chamakdar peela. Nitrate sodium hydroxide aur aluminium powder ke saath garam karne par ammonia deta hai, jo laal litmus neela karti hai, aur sulfate barium nitrate se bhari safed precipitate deta hai. Cations mein sodium hydroxide aluminium se safed gelatinous precipitate, ammonium se ammonia gas, calcium (zyada mein na-halne wala) aur zinc (zyada mein halne wala) se safed precipitates, chromium (zyada mein halne wala) aur iron(II) (orange-bhoora hone wala) se sabz, copper se halka neela aur iron(III) se orange-bhoora deta hai; aqueous ammonia phir unhen alag karta hai, calcium se taqreeban kuch nahi, copper se gehra neela solution, aur zinc ka precipitate dobara hal.

blocks.prompt: Carbonate ko bicarbonate se alag karein, nitrate ka ring test bayan karein, aur pani mein na-halne wale kuch sulfates ke naam dein (Quick Check 16.3; MCQ V, VI, VII; exercise Q.5).
blocks.explanation: Carbonate aur hydrogen carbonate dono halke acid se jhaag dete hain, magar carbonate solution thande mein magnesium sulfate se safed precipitate deta hai jabke hydrogen carbonate sirf ubalne par; aur hydrogen carbonates garam karne par toot kar CO2 dete hain jabke zyada tar carbonates (ammonium aur zyada darja hararat par alkaline earth dhaton ke siwa) nahi. Brown ring test: nitrate solution mein taza bana iron(II) sulfate solution dalein, phir ghaliz sulfuric acid aahista tube ki deewar se utarein; jor par [Fe(H2O)5NO]2+ ka bhoora chhalla banta hai: NO3- + 3Fe2+ + 4H+ -> NO + 3Fe3+ + 2H2O, phir Fe2+ + NO -> [Fe(NO)]2+ (bhoora chhalla). Pani mein na-halne wale sulfates mein barium sulfate BaSO4, lead(II) sulfate PbSO4 aur strontium sulfate SrSO4 shamil hain (calcium sulfate CaSO4 sirf thora halta hai). Chromyl chloride test (MCQ VI) chloride ki tasdeeq karta hai.

items: CO3 2-: halka HCl, jhaag, lime water doodhiya. Halides: halka HNO3 phir AgNO3; AgCl safed (NH3 mein halne wala), AgBr cream-peela, AgI chamakdar peela. NO3-: NaOH + Al powder, ammonia, laal litmus neela. SO4 2-: halka HNO3 phir Ba(NO3)2, bhari safed BaSO4. Halka HNO3 pehle carbonate hatata hai.
